name: gitlab-mcp-scripts
description: Workflow scripts for gitlab-mcp — docker compose lifecycle, bootstrap, tests

scripts.gitlab:up: docker compose -f tests/docker-compose.yml up -d gitlab && npm run gitlab:bootstrap
scripts.runner:logs: docker compose -f tests/docker-compose.yml --profile ci logs -f gitlab-runner
scripts.runner:down: docker compose -f tests/docker-compose.yml --profile ci rm -sfv gitlab-runner && docker volume rm tests_gitlab_runner_config 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.heptapod:up: docker compose -f tests/docker-compose.yml --profile heptapod up -d heptapod && npm run heptapod:bootstrap
scripts.test:integration:full: npm run gitlab:up && npm run test:integration; rv=$?; npm run gitlab:down; exit $rv
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:integration && npm run test:integration:waiters && npm run heptapod:up && npm run test:integration:heptapod; rv=$?; npm run gitlab:bootstrap; exit $rv
scripts.lint: uv run ruff check src/ tests/ scripts/
scripts.typecheck: uv run mypy src/gitlab_mcp tests scripts
